# Lucy

## Appearance

She is thin, plain, and small for her age, with a pale, freckled face, a sharp chin, a wide mouth, and large gray eyes that can turn green in different lights. She has long, thick, bright red hair usually worn in two tight braids. While initially wearing unattractive orphanage winsey frocks, she later wears practical, simple dresses sewn by Thirza, eventually acquiring stylish outfits with puffed sleeves.

_Sources: [v1 c2 P13](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0013), [v1 c2 P14](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0014), [v1 c2 P19](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0019), [v1 c2 P37](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0037), [v1 c3 P0](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0000), [v1 c9 P14](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0014), [v1 c11 P2](../source/v01-c11.md#nw-v01-c11-p0002), [v1 c25 P34](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0034), [v2 c1 P0](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0000)_

## Personality

Imaginative, romantic, and extremely talkative, she possesses a passionate nature and a fierce temper when teased about her appearance. She is eager to love and be loved, showing deep affection, gratitude, and loyalty to her kindred spirits. Though impulsive and prone to getting into dramatic scrapes, she is intensely honest, conscientious, and always eager to reform her faults.

_Sources: [v1 c2 P19](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0019), [v1 c2 P24](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0024), [v1 c2 P26](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0026), [v1 c4 P36](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0036), [v1 c9 P16](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0016), [v1 c10 P43](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0043), [v1 c12 P46](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0046), [v1 c28 P45](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0045)_

## History

Brought mistakenly to Grey Shutters by Obed Abernethy instead of the expected orphan boy, Nell quickly wins over Obed and Thirza Abernethy with her loquaciousness and vivid imagination, earning a permanent home. Soon after arriving, she loses her temper at Mrs. Agatha Sowerby for mocking her looks, but later delivers a dramatically sincere apology. She forms a deep 'bosom friendship' with Isolde Pembroke, naming their playhouse 'Larkrise'. When school resumes, she clashes fiercely with Hugh Carrow after he pulls her braid and calls her 'Carrots', breaking a slate over his head and harboring a long feud against him. She drops out of school temporarily due to an unjust punishment from teacher Mr. Pidgeon, but later returns, competing academically against Hugh. She inadvertently gets Isolde 'drunk' on homemade currant wine by mistaking it for raspberry cordial, causing a temporary rift with Mrs. Pembroke until she saves the life of the Pembrokes' croup-afflicted baby, Posy Fay. Later, when accused of stealing Thirza's amethyst brooch, she invents a dramatic confession about losing it in the lake to escape room confinement and attend a picnic; after Thirza finds the brooch in her own shawl, Nell is forgiven and allowed to attend. Over the next few years, she excels in school, builds close friendships, and studies rigorously for the Regent's College Entrance exams. She eventually places first on the Island on the Entrance examinations, ties with Hugh, and wins the prestigious Avery Scholarship.

## Background by volume

- Born in Harborough, Nova Scotia to high school teachers Edmund and Bertha Harcourt, who both died of fever when she was three months old  <sub>[v1 c5 P11](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0011), [v1 c5 P13](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0013)</sub>
- Raised by hand by the impoverished Mrs. Thomas until age eight, helping care for her children  <sub>[v1 c5 P13](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0013), [v1 c5 P14](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0014)</sub>
- Lived in a clearing with Mrs. Rudge for over two years, caring for three consecutive sets of twins  <sub>[v1 c5 P14](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0014), [v1 c5 P15](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0015)</sub>
- Spent four months in the Marden orphan asylum before being brought mistakenly to Grey Shutters  <sub>[v1 c1 P23](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0023), [v1 c2 P19](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0019), [v1 c5 P15](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0015)</sub>
